links.outcome: SMOG readability of chatbot responses on mandibular distraction osteogenesis counseling
links.effect: Mean SMOG 17.31 (SD 3.59), graduate school reading level; Open Evidence 22.24 vs ChatGPT 15.89, Gemini 15.66, Copilot 15.44 (P<0.001).
links.quote: Significant differences in readability across all AI models were found (mean=17.31 SD=3.59, P <0.001), indicating the average response was at a graduate school reading level.

links.outcome: Modified DISCERN scores for citation of sources and additional sources provided
links.effect: Additional sources provided mean=2.19 (SD 1.52); citation of sources mean=2.93 (SD 1.96), the lowest-scoring items.
links.quote: Additional sources provided and citation of sources had the lowest means (mean=2.19 SD=1.52; mean=2.93 SD=1.96).

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on 20 common preoperative and postoperative questions for mandibular distraction osteogenesis using modified DISCERN and readability metrics (SMOG), without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
